bio:
Kianna joined The Pet Studio with a lifelong love of animals and a strong desire to learn everything she can about professional dog grooming. Growing up surrounded by pets, caring for animals has always felt natural to her.

As an apprentice, she is gaining hands-on experience, developing her grooming knowledge and learning how to work confidently with dogs of different breeds and personalities. Kianna brings warmth and enthusiasm to the salon. When she is not working, she enjoys music, spending time with friends and being with the animals that have always been an important part of her life.
